description: Test whether the conserved exposed surface of the LRCH1 CH domain forms a patch and where it sits relative to the actin-equivalent face
code:
import numpy as np, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
cons=json.load(open('ch_work/conservation.json'))
sas=json.load(open('ch_work/sasa.json'))
rsa={int(k):v for k,v in sas['rsa'].items()}; aa={int(k):v for k,v in sas['aa'].items()}
resn=cons['resnum']; c=np.array(cons['cons']); iface=set(sas['iface'])
dom=json.load(open('ch_work/domains.json'))
CA={r:np.array(x) for r,x in zip(dom['LRCH1_HUMAN_CH']['resnum'],dom['LRCH1_HUMAN_CH']['ca'])}

surf=[r for r in resn if rsa.get(r,0)>0.20]
cmap={r:c[resn.index(r)] for r in resn}
inv_surf=[r for r in surf if cmap[r]==1.0]          # invariant across 7 metazoan orthologs AND exposed
print(f"solvent-exposed residues (RSA>0.20): {len(surf)}")
print(f"of these, invariant in all 7 orthologs: {len(inv_surf)}")
print("invariant exposed residues:", ", ".join(f"{aa[r]}{r}" for r in inv_surf))
print("  of which on the actin-interface-equivalent face:", sum(r in iface for r in inv_surf),
      "->", ", ".join(f"{aa[r]}{r}" for r in inv_surf if r in iface))

# spatial clustering: is the invariant exposed set more clustered than random exposed sets?
def meanpair(rs):
    X=np.array([CA[r] for r in rs]); D=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None]-X[None],axis=2)
    return D[np.triu_indices(len(rs),1)].mean()
obs=meanpair(inv_surf)
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
null=[meanpair(list(rng.choice(surf,len(inv_surf),replace=False))) for _ in range(5000)]
null=np.array(null); p=(null<=obs).mean()
print(f"\nmean pairwise CA distance of invariant exposed residues: {obs:.2f} A")
print(f"random exposed sets of same size: {null.mean():.2f} +/- {null.std():.2f} A; empirical p(clustered) = {p:.4f}")

# where is the conserved patch relative to the actin face? project onto vector between centroids
Xif=np.array([CA[r] for r in sorted(iface) if r in CA]); Xinv=np.array([CA[r] for r in inv_surf])
Xall=np.array([CA[r] for r in resn])
print(f"centroid distance, invariant-exposed patch vs actin-face centroid: {np.linalg.norm(Xinv.mean(0)-Xif.mean(0)):.1f} A")
print(f"domain radius of gyration: {np.sqrt(((Xall-Xall.mean(0))**2).sum(1).mean()):.1f} A")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
ax.hist(null,bins=50,color='#cbd5e0'); ax.axvline(obs,color='#c53030',lw=2)
ax.set_xlabel('mean pairwise CA distance (A)'); ax.set_ylabel('random draws')
ax.set_title(f'Invariant exposed residues of LRCH1 CH are spatially clustered\n(observed {obs:.1f} A, p={p:.3f}, 5000 random exposed sets)')
ax=axes[1]
col=['#c53030' if (cmap[r]==1.0 and rsa.get(r,0)>0.2) else ('#f6ad55' if r in iface else '#cbd5e0') for r in resn]
ax.scatter([rsa.get(r,0) for r in resn],[cmap[r] for r in resn],c=col,s=22)
ax.set_xlabel('relative solvent accessibility'); ax.set_ylabel('ortholog identity (7 species)')
ax.set_title('Conservation vs exposure, LRCH1 CH domain\norange = actin-interface-equivalent position')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
json.dump({'invariant_exposed':inv_surf,'obs':obs,'p':float(p)},open('ch_work/conserved_patch.json','w'))
